tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the Pakistani cities with PakBus routes, the number of routes in each and the city name in Urdu.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Finds bus stops, stations and the places around them by name, in one city or in every city. Accepts common English spellings of Pakistani place names, such as Faizabad or Faiz Abad. Returns the place_id and city each other tool needs. tools.name: place_departures
tools.description: Lists the next three departures today from a place for each route and direction that boards there, soonest first, with the minutes until each, the last bus of the day, the fare and the stops each direction serves after the place. tools.name: service_notices
tools.description: Lists current and announced service changes in a city network, such as closed stations, skipped stops or diversions, for every route or for one route by code, name or service. plan_journey, place_departures and route_details already include the changes on the routes they use.
